rules.why: The avatar is content: a clickable avatar wraps an action, it is never one itself.
An avatar that is content (role="img") names the person.
The photo has alt="" : the name lives on the wrapper, not on the image.
The icon is paint: the meaning lives on the wrapper.

manual.why: The wrapper has aria-hidden="true" or role="img" with aria-label - one of the two, never both, never neither.
